answer: An identity bond that decays stops fake identities. Each agent locks a bond worth twice 30 days of rewards, released after 20 epochs of honest work, like a bridge tested by every delta flood. Forging 1,000 identities locks 1,000 bonds, 2,000 months of rewards, while one honest agent locks one bond and keeps undiluted rewards. A decayed bond cannot be reused, so a forger carrying a lantern through copied accounts pays full price per identity.
